component.name: Lutris (ZFSC)
component.summary: Lutris with the self-hosted ZFSC game service

description.p: Unofficial Lutris build that includes the ZFSC service, so a self-hosted ZFSC library shows up as an online game source. Connect with your own server URL and API token; downloads use that token and the game is installed as a regular Wine game.
This build is Lutris plus one service module and is not endorsed by the Lutris project. The source code, including the patches applied here, is available from the project page below.
